description: Durable-inbox routing (SPEC §8.1): per-conversation queue_id derivation. queue_seed = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=device_sk, salt='', info='oc-lock-chat/inbox-queue-seed/v1', L=32); queue_id(c) = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(queue_seed, utf8(conversation_id))) unpadded; bootstrap_id = base64url(SHA-256(utf8('oc-lock-chat/inbox-bootstrap/v1:'||inbox_pubkey_hex))). Proves: the id is recomputable from device_sk + conversation_id alone (no stored map), and two conversations on the SAME device yield UNLINKABLE queue ids — so a store-and-forward operator sees N independent queues, never a recipient pubkey or Bitcoin address. Reuses the vc04 recipient device for a coherent set.
notes: queue_seed MUST NOT be published and MUST NOT leave the device unencrypted. queue_id is base64url WITHOUT padding (43 chars for 32 bytes). The bootstrap queue carries the SPEC §8.1.2 / SECURITY S6 recipient-linkability and is used only for first contact; the per-conversation queue_id is exchanged inside the AEAD payload (§5 recv_queue) thereafter. Reproduce with: queue_seed=HKDF-SHA256(device_sk,'',info,32); queue_id=base64url(HMAC-SHA256(queue_seed,conversation_id)).
